Marie: Heads up — I opened a tiny PR to consolidate our v1->v2 compatibility checklist and capture the common gotchas for model swaps + SDK breaking changes. Looking for 1-2 reviewers before I merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/578 :eyes:

Alex: Thanks — quick q: should we include an explicit before/after snippet for the old `/v1/models` direct call vs new v2 client? I think showing a side-by-side helps people port fast.

Alex: Example (old -> new):
```
# v1 REST (old)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/text-gen/outputs -d '{"input":"hi"}' 

# v2 SDK (new)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.responses.create(model="redwood-alpha", input="hi")
print(resp.output[0].content)
```

Kai: FYI the model mapping link in the checklist points to docs/models.md#mapping but we moved that section into docs/reference/model-catalog.md and changed the anchor. Link-checker will flag it.

docs-bot: PR #578 preview build started — running link-checker and snippet linter.

docs-bot: link-checker found: 1) docs/guides/compatibility.md -> broken anchor `#mapping`, 2) docs/snippets/sdk-v2.md -> missing code fence end.

Priya: I'll pick up the anchor + code fence. Also propose we add a short note about caching/kvs when swapping model variants: customers need to warm the KV cache or expect higher latency for first few requests. Suggest text: "When swapping to a different model family, warm up the model by issuing a few short requests to populate the KV cache; otherwise cold-start latency can spike."

Alex: Good call. Also add a tiny section showing how to configure graceful fallback in routing (example YAML) and the SDK pattern for function-calling differences in v2 vs v1.

Alex: Example streaming snippet for v2 (inline):
```
# streaming (v2 SDK)
with client.responses.stream(model="redwood-stream", input="summarize this") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Marie: Can we also put the deprecation timeline at the top of the checklist? Folks need dates. Proposal: announce + migration docs by 2026-04-15, soft-sunsetting warnings in SDKs by 2026-05-15, full v1 retire on 2026-07-01. Thoughts?

Kai: Dates look fine to me. Make sure the SDK changelog callouts appear in the v2 SDK release notes (I'll file the TODO in the SDK board).

Priya: I'll open PR to fix the links, finish the code fences, add the kv-cache warmup paragraph, and include the before/after snippets (REST vs v2 SDK) + streaming example. Will tag Alex & Marie for review once ready.

Alex: ping me once the PR is green. I can add the routing YAML snippet and double-check the function-calling example.

Kai: I'll update the model-catalog anchor in the redirect map so the old links keep working for a bit.

Priya: noted. I'll include a small "what changed" blurb at the top to help product docs writers.

Marie: Perfect. That should cover the major deprecation gotchas.
